note: The soundtrack items sold on the Cosmetics screen (the creator, 2026-10-29): cosmetic platform items a player buys once for Coins, never traded, never written by the game. The one place a track's slug, id, title and price live; read by src/net/tracks.ts (the game) and tools/server/make-config.mts (the items and the cosmetics catalog in the game config). The slugs are Audio's (public/audio/<slug>.*); the id is made once from the slug by make-config and never changes once uploaded. `trip`: the trip in src/content/levels/trips.json the track belongs to. Every player's own track, track-sunny-day, is no item.
